chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, tua thuciamna eite tawh kikum ahih ciangin i pumpi kihhuainate leh lungsim kihhuainate khempeuh panin kisiangthosakin, Pasian kihta-in, a siangtho gamtatna tawh dimin om ni.
Kote ading na lungsim uh na za sak un. Kote in kuamah tungah ka khial kei uh hi. Kuamah ka bawlsia kei uh hi. Kuamah kheemin a sum ka la kei uh hi.

Note hong mawhsak nadingin hih bang ka ci kei hi. No tawh nuntak khawm nadingin ahi zongin, sih khawm nadingin ahi zongin ka deih dongin note ka lungtang sungah kong it hi ci-in tuma-in ka hong ci zo hi.
Note kiangah lau loin ka hong ci hi; note hangin ka kisathei mahmah hi. Hehnepna tawh ka dim hi. Ka thuakna uh gimna khempeuh ah a kigen thei loin ka lungdamzaw hi.
Makedonia gamah ka tun’ uh ciangin ka pumpi ading tawlngakna bangmah om lo hi. Na khempeuh panin bawlsiatna ka thuak uh hi. Pua lamah kidona a om hi, sung lamah launa a om hi.
Ahih hangin a kinuaisiah mite a hehnem thei Pasian in Titu hong tun’na hangin kote hong hehnem hi.

Titu hong tun’na hang bekin hong kihehnem hi loin note kiangah Titu in a ngah hehnepna hangin zong hong hehnemsak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na lunggulhna uh, na thuumna uh, komau phat nading na deihna lungsim uh a lian hi, ci-in kote kiangah a hong gen ciangin ka lung uh a dam semsem hi.
Tuma-a kong khak lai in note hong dahsak hangin a masa-in ka kisik zongin tu-in ka kisik kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua lai in note tawlkhat bek hong dahsak hi cih ka thei hi.

No hong dahsak ahih maninah a nuam ka hi kei hi, hong dahsaka hong kisiksak ahih manin ka lung a dam hi. Kote hangin note noptuamna uh a neukha beek a kisiat loh nadingin Pasian’ deihna tawh kituakin ka hong dahsak hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ deihna tawh kituak dahna in hong gup nading tawh kizom kisik kikna lungsim hi a, a kikheel kik thei lo kisikna lungsim hong pia hi. Leitunga dahna in sihna a piangsak hi.

Pasian’ deihna tawh kituak note dahna in note sungah bang ci bang phawkna, bang ci bang mawh kiphelna, bang ci bang hehna, bang ci bang launa, bang ci bang lunggulhna, bang ci bang deihna lungsim, bang ci bang thuman tawh daan piak thu-a bawlphatna ci-in en ta un. Note in hih thu sung pan mawhsakna tawh na kipelh uh hi ci-in na khempeuh hangin na lak zo uh hi.

Tua mah bangin keimah in note kiangah gelh a, kong piak ciangin mawhna a hih mi leh mawhna a thuak mi bek ngaihsuna gelh ka hi kei hi; kote phattuamna ading Pasian mai-ah bawl nopna lungsim na neih uh na kilatsak nadingun ka hong gelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in hehnepna ka ngah zo uh hi. Tua hehnepna-ah zong note khempeuh in Titu’ lungsim na noptuamsak zo uh a, ama lungdamna hangin kote ka lungdam semsem uh hi.

Keimah in note hangin ka kisaktheihna kam ama kiangah ka gen zo ahih ciangin tu-in ka zum nading a om kei hi. Kote in na khempeuh note kiangah thuman kong gen uh bangin Titu mai-ah ka kisaktheihna kam zong a mantak ahih lam a kitel hi.
Note in launa leh liin’na tawh amah na tungsak uh a, a thu na ngaihna uh amah in a ngaihsut ciangin note hong itna hehpihna lungsim a dim hi.
Keimah in na khempeuhah note tawh kipawlin ka lungmuang semsem a, ka nuam hi.
